procedures.title: Front wheel bearings: adjust
notes: Front suspension lubrication intervals are in Section 0 of the manual; this section covers only adjustments and repairs.
Unless a procedure names a model, it applies to all five car lines in the manual (Corvette included).
Figures 1 and 2 on this page show the Chevrolet and Chevelle front suspensions (not Corvette).
